title: Price of Anarchy of First-Price Auctions in Agentic Markets

paragraphs.en: An agentic market is a decentralized serving-time market where AI agents bid to claim each user prompt. An agent’s bid is based on its expected value for the prompt, which is the expectation of the reward for its response minus its inference costs. First-price auctions (FPAs), in which the highest bidder pays its bid and receives the prompt, are a natural way to allocate prompts in such a market, since they are simple and transparent to run, and do not require central knowledge of private capabilities and costs. However, FPAs are not truthful: participants may bid less than their true value in the hope of a larger profit, and the prompt may then be allocated to someone other than the bidder who values it the most. This welfare loss is quantified by the price-of-anarchy (PoA). In this paper, we argue that agentic markets are likely to possess features that reduce the price-of-anarchy. The first is a competitive floor , which occurs when multiple bidders usually value the prompt above some baseline share of the optimal welfare (e.g., because the best models are often distilled into cheaper alternatives, which perform similarly). We show that competition among them then limits the welfare loss, which can be driven to zero as the floor rises. The second feature is near-independence of values after conditioning on the prompt, which occurs when most of the predictable variation in the expected value is determined by the difficulty of the prompt. As the value distribution approaches conditional independence, we can derive an efficiency guarantee that approaches a factor of 1 − 1 / e 2 1-1/e^{2} of the optimal welfare. Thus, both features give rise to welfare lower bounds that are significantly better than the well-known general case of 1 − 1 / e 1-1/e . We validate these results empirically using auctions with strategic bidders simulated on the EmbedLLM prompt routing dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体市场是一种去中心化的服务时间市场，其中人工智能智能体通过竞价来争取每个用户提示。 智能体的出价基于其对提示的预期价值，即其响应的预期奖励减去推理成本。 第一价格拍卖（FPA）——最高出价者支付其出价并获得提示——是此类市场中分配提示的自然方式，因为这种拍卖机制简单透明，且无需对私有能力和成本有集中了解。 然而，第一价格拍卖并非真实机制：参与者可能会为了追求更高利润而出价低于其真实价值，导致提示最终被分配给并非最重视该提示的出价者。 这种福利损失可通过“无政府价格”（PoA）进行量化。 在本文中，我们认为智能体市场很可能具备能够降低无政府价格的特征。 第一个特征是竞争底线，即当多个出价者通常对提示的估值高于最优福利的某个基准份额时出现（例如，因为最佳模型往往被蒸馏为价格更低的替代模型，而后者表现相似）。 我们证明，它们之间的竞争会限制福利损失，并且随着竞争底线的提升，这种损失甚至可以趋近于零。 第二个特征是，在给定提示后，各智能体的估值几乎相互独立；这是因为预期价值中的可预测变化主要由提示的难度决定。 当价值分布趋近于条件独立时，我们可以推导出一个效率保证：其结果将接近最优福利的 $1 - 1/e^2$ 倍。 因此，这两个特征共同带来了显著优于著名一般情况 $1 - 1/e$ 的福利下界。 我们通过在 EmbedLLM 提示路由数据集上模拟具有策略性出价者的拍卖，对这一结果进行了实证验证。

paragraphs.en: Consider a user with a task that could be serviced by any one of many AI agents, where each AI agent has a different expected cost and response quality. The user could choose among the agents directly, but that requires knowledge about every option on the market. Alternatively, aggregators and routers can make this choice on the user’s behalf—e.g., by establishing a central view of which agent is good at which tasks, and directing users’ prompts accordingly ( Ding et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Aubakirova et al., 2025 ) . That view has to be measured and maintained, however, which becomes harder as the candidate pool grows beyond well-known providers. A third, and emerging, approach is the "agentic market," which is a serving-time market where possible responding agents bid to claim each prompt, and are rewarded according to the quality of the response they provide ( Qi et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Each responder is assumed to privately know (or estimate) its expected quality and cost on the current prompt, which the market must elicit efficiently and transparently, without assuming that responders are honest. Being decentralized, the market also scales with the number of participants rather than with the platform’s ability to track them.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一个用户有一项任务，这项任务可以由众多 AI 智能体中的任意一个来完成，而每个 AI 智能体的预期成本和响应质量都各不相同。 用户可以直接在这些智能体中进行选择，但这需要用户对市场上所有选项都有充分的了解。 另一种方法是，由聚合器和路由器代表用户做出这一选择——例如，通过建立一个集中视图来明确哪个智能体擅长哪些任务，并据此引导用户的提示（Ding et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Aubakirova et al., 2025）。 然而，这种集中视图需要被衡量和持续维护，而随着候选智能体的范围扩展到知名提供商之外，这项工作会变得越来越困难。 第三种新兴方法是“智能体市场”，这是一种服务时长的市场机制：可能响应的智能体通过竞标来争取处理每个提示的机会，并根据其提供的响应质量获得奖励（Qi et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2026）。 假设每个响应者都私下了解（或能够估算）自己在当前提示上的预期质量和成本，而市场必须高效且透明地获取这些信息，同时无需假设响应者是诚实的。 由于是去中心化的，该市场的规模会随着参与者的数量而扩展，而不是受限于平台追踪这些参与者的能力。

paragraphs.en: The main design choice in such a market is how to allocate prompts based on the agents’ bids, and what price to charge the agent who wins the auction. Many mechanisms exist, and recent work on agentic markets has largely favored those that are dominant-strategy incentive compatible, such as second-price and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) variants, under which bidding one’s true value is optimal regardless of what other bidders do ( Chang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在这种市场中，主要的设计决策在于如何根据智能体的出价分配提示词，以及向赢得拍卖的智能体收取多少费用。 目前存在多种机制，而近期关于智能体市场的研究大多倾向于那些具有占优策略激励相容性的机制，例如第二价格拍卖和维克瑞-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）变体；在这些机制下，无论其他竞标者如何行动，报出真实价值都是最优选择（Chang 等，2020；Liu 等，2026；Cao 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we analyze the viability of the first-price auction (FPA), which is an especially simple mechanism. Here, each responder bids for the right to service the current prompt. The highest bidder wins, pays its bid to the platform, submits its response, and collects a reward based on quality Qi et al. (2026) ; Chang et al. (2020) . FPAs have several advantages. The payment rule is transparent, since the winner pays its own bid, with no need to trust the platform to truthfully report a second price ( Rothkopf et al., 1990 ) . Bidders can be strategic, but do not need to be: a nonnegative bid below expected quality minus cost results in a nonnegative expected surplus when it wins, regardless of what others bid. FPAs are also simple to implement, which partly explains why some of the largest markets, such as display advertising auctions, use them ( Cox, 2019 ; Paes Leme et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们分析了第一价格拍卖（FPA）的可行性，这是一种特别简单的机制。 在此，每个响应者都会出价以获取服务当前提示的权利。 最高出价者获胜，向平台支付其出价，提交其响应，并根据质量获得奖励 Qi et al. (2026) ; Chang et al. (2020) 。 FPA 具有多种优势。 支付规则是透明的，因为获胜者只需支付自己的出价，无需信任平台会如实报告第二价格（ Rothkopf et al., 1990 ） 。 出价者可以具有策略性，但并非必须如此：一个非负的、低于预期质量减去成本的出价，无论他人如何出价，在获胜时都会带来非负的预期盈余。 FPA 也易于实施，这在一定程度上解释了为何一些最大的市场（如展示广告拍卖）会采用它（ Cox, 2019 ; Paes Leme et al., 2020 ） 。

paragraphs.en: While FPAs are successful in practice, they are less appreciated in theory. Unlike VCG-style mechanisms, first-price auctions are not truthful: strategic agents “shade” their bids below their true values to increase profit, and if higher-valued agents shade too aggressively, they can lose to lower-valued agents, which decreases social welfare (the total value generated by the allocation). The ratio of the welfare at a strategic equilibrium to the best achievable welfare is called the price of anarchy ( Roughgarden et al., 2017 ) , and for FPAs it can be as low as 1 − 1 / e ≈ 63 % 1-1/e\approx 63\% ( Syrgkanis and Tardos, 2013 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管第一价格拍卖（FPAs）在实践中取得了成功，但在理论上却鲜受重视。 与VCG类机制不同，第一价格拍卖并非真实现金支付机制：策略性智能体会将出价“压低”至其真实价值以下以增加利润；如果价值更高的智能体压价过于激进，甚至可能输给价值更低的智能体，从而降低社会福利（即分配所产生的总价值）。 策略均衡下的社会福利与可实现的最佳社会福利之比被称为“无政府价格”（Roughgarden等，2017），而对于第一价格拍卖，该比率最低可达1 − 1 / e ≈ 63%（Syrgkanis和Tardos，2013）。

paragraphs.en: A potential 1 / e ≈ 37 % {1}/{e}\approx 37\% loss in efficiency may seem severe, but it is a worst case bound over arbitrary value distributions. We empirically show that in representative agentic markets simulated on the large-scale EmbedLLM dataset Zhuang et al. (2025) , realized welfare losses are often much smaller. To understand this gap between theory and practice, we derive new bounds that show that the worst case improves substantially under structural conditions that are natural in agentic markets. The primary condition is a competitive floor , which occurs when several bidders usually value the query above a certain baseline. Competition among these bidders then keeps the winning bid high and limits how much welfare can be lost. Competitive floor conditions can arise when agents have comparable substitutes, e.g., due to distillation or similar training data and capabilities ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Aubakirova et al., 2025 ) . Our bounds depend on how many bidders are competitive, how high the floor is, and how reliably it holds. As a secondary result, we show that the PoA bound can also improve through near-independence , even when no such floor exists. When bidder values are independent, Jin and Lu (2023a) show that the price of anarchy improves to 1 − 1 / e 2 ≈ 86.5 % 1-1/e^{2}\approx 86.5\% . We prove that this guarantee still holds approximately under small perturbations from independence in terms of total-variation distance. This is practically relevant because shared query features (such as prompt difficulty or type) account for much of the co-movement across models; the idea being that once this information is conditioned out, the residual dependence may be much weaker.

sents.en: A potential 1 / e ≈ 37 % {1}/{e}\approx 37\% loss in efficiency may seem severe, but it is a worst case bound over arbitrary value distributions.
sents.zh: 效率可能存在的 1 / e ≈ 37 % {1}/{e}\approx 37\% 的下降看似严重，但这是针对任意值分布的最坏情况界限。

sents.en: We empirically show that in representative agentic markets simulated on the large-scale EmbedLLM dataset Zhuang et al.
sents.zh: 我们通过实证表明，在基于大型 EmbedLLM 数据集（Zhuang 等人，2025）模拟的代表性智能体市场中，实际实现的福利损失通常要小得多。

sents.en: (2025) , realized welfare losses are often much smaller.
sents.zh: （2025），实际实现的福利损失往往要小得多。

sents.en: To understand this gap between theory and practice, we derive new bounds that show that the worst case improves substantially under structural conditions that are natural in agentic markets.
sents.zh: 为了理解理论与实践之间的这一差距，我们推导出了新的界限，表明在智能体市场中自然存在的结构性条件下，最坏情况会显著改善。

sents.en: The primary condition is a competitive floor , which occurs when several bidders usually value the query above a certain baseline.
sents.zh: 主要条件是一个竞争底线，即当多个竞标者通常将查询的价值评估高于某个基准时出现的情况。

sents.en: Competition among these bidders then keeps the winning bid high and limits how much welfare can be lost.
sents.zh: 这些竞标者之间的竞争会维持较高的中标价格，并限制福利损失的程度。

sents.en: Competitive floor conditions can arise when agents have comparable substitutes, e.g., due to distillation or similar training data and capabilities ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Aubakirova et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 当智能体拥有可比较的替代方案时，例如由于蒸馏或类似的训练数据和能力（Cao 等人，2026；Aubakirova 等人，2025），竞争底线条件便可能出现。

sents.en: Our bounds depend on how many bidders are competitive, how high the floor is, and how reliably it holds.
sents.zh: 我们的界限取决于有多少竞标者具有竞争力、底线的高度以及该底线的可靠性。

sents.en: As a secondary result, we show that the PoA bound can also improve through near-independence , even when no such floor exists.
sents.zh: 作为次要结果，我们证明，即使不存在这样的竞争底线，通过近似独立性，价格无效率（PoA）的界限也可以得到改善。

sents.en: When bidder values are independent, Jin and Lu (2023a) show that the price of anarchy improves to 1 − 1 / e 2 ≈ 86.5 % 1-1/e^{2}\approx 86.5\% .
sents.zh: 当竞标者的价值相互独立时，Jin 和 Lu（2023a）指出，价格无效率会改善至 1 − 1 / e 2 ≈ 86.5 % 1-1/e^{2}\approx 86.5\%。

sents.en: We prove that this guarantee still holds approximately under small perturbations from independence in terms of total-variation distance.
sents.zh: 我们证明了，在总变差距离方面，只要与独立性存在较小的扰动，这一保证仍然近似成立。

sents.en: This is practically relevant because shared query features (such as prompt difficulty or type) account for much of the co-movement across models; the idea being that once this information is conditioned out, the residual dependence may be much weaker.
sents.zh: 这在实践中具有重要意义，因为共享的查询特征（如提示难度或类型）导致了模型间的大部分协同变化；其核心思想是，一旦通过条件化消除了这些信息，剩余的依赖关系可能会弱得多。

paragraphs.en: These results show that when models (1) compete closely on capability or (2) share task difficulty that can be conditioned out, the equilibrium allocation preserves substantially more welfare than worst-case theory predicts. Much of the motivation for more complex mechanisms then falls away—the simple and transparent FPA can already capture most of the available welfare under conditions that agentic markets tend to satisfy. A market platform also does not have to treat these conditions as purely exogenous. In retail, for example, operators often stock “private labels” alongside third-party sellers to discipline markups ( Shopova, 2023 ; Ding et al., 2025 ) . In the same spirit, we examine how a platform can steer market conditions, either by introducing its own model to increase competition (acting like a reserve price) or by filtering out low-performing responders before bidding begins.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，当模型（1）在能力上高度竞争，或（2）共享可通过条件调整消除的任务难度时，均衡分配所保留的福利要远高于最坏情况理论所预测的水平。 因此，推动采用更复杂机制的许多动机便不复存在——在智能体市场通常满足的条件下，简单透明的 FPA 已经能够捕捉到大部分可用福利。 此外，市场平台也不必将这些条件完全视为外生因素。 例如在零售领域，运营商通常会与第三方卖家一同上架“自有品牌”商品，以抑制价格溢价（Shopova, 2023；Ding et al., 2025）。 基于同样的思路，我们研究了平台如何引导市场条件：既可以通过引入自身模型来增强竞争（类似于设定保留价），也可以在竞价开始前筛选掉表现不佳的响应者。

paragraphs.en: Contributions of this work. In summary, this paper provides theoretical and empirical tools to analyze first-price auctions under what practitioners may expect from typical agentic market structure:
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的贡献。 总而言之，本文提供了理论和实证工具，用于分析第一价格拍卖，这些分析基于实践者可能对典型智能体市场结构所预期的情况：

sents.en: Contributions of this work.
sents.zh: 本研究的贡献。

sents.en: In summary, this paper provides theoretical and empirical tools to analyze first-price auctions under what practitioners may expect from typical agentic market structure:
sents.zh: 总而言之，本文提供了理论和实证工具，用于分析第一价格拍卖，这些分析基于实践者可能对典型智能体市场结构所预期的情况：

paragraphs.en: Competitive floors (§ 3 ): We derive price-of-anarchy bounds that improve when several bidders usually value the query above a certain baseline, a fixed fraction of the optimal welfare.
paragraphs.zh: 竞争性楼层（第 3 节）：我们推导出了无政府状态价格的下界，当下多个竞标者通常对查询的估值高于某个基准值——即最优社会福利的一个固定比例时，该下界会得到改善。

paragraphs.en: Near-independence (§ 4 ): We show the 1 − 1 / e 2 1-1/e^{2} bound for independent values ( Jin and Lu, 2023a ) still holds approximately when values are nearly independent after conditioning on the query.
paragraphs.zh: 近似独立性（§4）：我们证明了，在给定查询后，当各值近似独立时，独立值情形下的 1 − 1 / e 2 1-1/e^{2} 界（Jin and Lu, 2023a）仍然大致成立。

paragraphs.en: Platform design (§ 5 ): We show that platforms can create these conditions, by filtering out weak responders before bidding or by entering in-house models that act as reserve prices.
paragraphs.zh: 平台设计（第 5 节）：我们证明，平台可以通过在出价前筛选掉响应能力较弱的智能体，或引入作为保留价格的内部模型，来创造这些条件。

paragraphs.en: Empirical analysis (§ 6 ): On EmbedLLM ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) , we find that competitive floors and conditional independence emerge and yield high efficiency, even in adversarial equilibria.
paragraphs.zh: 实证分析（§ 6）：在 EmbedLLM（Zhuang 等人，2025）上，我们发现竞争底限和条件独立性会出现并带来高效率，即使在对抗性均衡中也是如此。

paragraphs.en: In a standard auction, the item for sale is the only source of randomness: each bidder knows its own value, which is random only from the perspective of others. But in agentic markets, the reward and cost of a response is typically not known until it is produced. Simply letting bidder i i take the expectation of the response reward minus cost reduces the setting to the standard one. If bidder i i wins the request and pays a price p i p_{i} , its expected payoff (or surplus ) is then simply v i − p i v_{i}-p_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 在标准拍卖中，待售物品是唯一的随机性来源：每位竞标者都知晓自己的价值，而这一价值仅从他人视角来看是随机的。 但在智能体市场中，响应的奖励和成本通常直到响应被生成之前都无法得知。 若仅让竞标者 i 取响应奖励与成本之差的期望值，该场景便会简化为标准拍卖情形。 如果竞标者 i 赢得请求并支付价格 p_i，其预期收益（或剩余价值）即为 v_i - p_i。

paragraphs.en: Intuitively, markets only require competition at the top (that is, just between the highest-valued bidders) to be efficient. In other words, it should be enough for more than one, but not all, bidders to usually value the query highly. We formalize this via a notion of a "competitive floor" for the market.
paragraphs.zh: 直观地说，市场只需在顶层（即仅最高出价者之间）存在竞争即可实现效率。 换言之，只要有多于一个但并非所有出价者通常对查询给予高价值，就应足以保证效率。 我们通过市场的“竞争底线”这一概念对此进行形式化描述。

paragraphs.en: Proposition 2 corresponds to a competitive floor with m = 2 m=2 and ϵ = 0 \epsilon=0 . That is, it requires at least two bidders to clear the floor on every query. This is not realistic: on unusual queries for instance, only one model may be able to do well, even if several models usually compete closely on most queries. When bidders know that a second credible competitor is sometimes lacking, they can shade more, and the winning bid may fall below the floor. paragraphs.en: In the previous section we showed that competitive floors on the values limit welfare loss. A separate question is how the dependence structure among values (or lack thereof) affects strategic behavior. More specifically, under independent private values (IPV; where V 1 ⟂ ⋯ ⟂ V n V_{1}\perp\dots\perp V_{n} ), Jin and Lu (2023a) show that the PoA improves from 1 − 1 / e ≈ 0.632 1-1/e\approx 0.632 to 1 − 1 / e 2 ≈ 0.865 1-1/e^{2}\approx 0.865 . In practice, bidder values are rarely strictly independent—yet they may be nearly independent. In agentic markets, values co-vary across queries due to shared task difficulty and similar model costs, but we conjecture that much of this common variation can be explained by observable query metadata. If so, once query metadata X X is observed (e.g., the prompt text, its topic, how response quality is measured, the model tiers of the other bidders, etc.), agent values may be approximately independent, where μ ⁡ ( v 1 , … , v n ∣ X ) ≈ ∏ i = 1 n μ i ​ ( v i ∣ X ) . \mu(v_{1},\ldots,v_{n}\mid X)\;\approx\;\prod_{i=1}^{n}\mu_{i}(v_{i}\mid X).

paragraphs.en: The market structure supporting our bounds is partly under the platform’s control, leading to some very simple design recommendations to protect market efficiency. In this section we explore what happens if the platform restricts which models bid on a query, or if it honestly enters its own in-house model (e.g., if it has privately developed one, or hosts an open-weight model) into the auction.
paragraphs.zh: 支撑我们界定的市场结构部分处于平台的控制之下，因此有必要提出一些非常简单的设计建议，以保护市场效率。 在本节中，我们将探讨如果平台限制哪些模型可以参与查询的竞价，或者如果它诚实地将其内部模型（例如，如果它私下开发了一个模型，或托管了一个开放权重的模型）引入拍卖时会发生什么。

paragraphs.en: Strategic bidding. Each model submits a sealed bid b i ​ ( q ) ≤ v i ​ ( q ) b_{i}(q)\leq v_{i}(q) for each query q q , and the highest bidder wins and pays its bid. We partition the prompts into 20 20 K K -means clusters using their embeddings, and bidders condition their strategies on the cluster and their own value v i ​ ( q ) v_{i}(q) . A bidder therefore knows the approximate type of prompt it is bidding on and its own estimated value, but knows its rivals’ values only through the prior distribution, conditioned on the cluster. Within each cluster we solve for (approximate) Bayes–Nash equilibria by fictitious play using a discretized grid over both values and possible bids (see Appendix D for details). Equilibria are not necessarily unique, and certain equilibria might have substantially worse welfare than others. We therefore solve every market twice: once for a typical equilibrium, where at each iteration bidders update their strategy to the best (surplus maximizing) response nearest its current bid until convergence, and once for an (also approximate) adversarial equilibrium, where at each iteration each bidder takes the welfare- minimizing response that still retains at most 5 % 5\% relative regret of its best possible individual surplus until convergence.
paragraphs.zh: 策略性出价。 对于每个查询 q，每个模型提交一个密封出价 b_i(q) ≤ v_i(q)，最高出价者获胜并支付其出价。 我们使用提示词的嵌入向量将其划分为 20 个 K-均值聚类，出价者根据所属聚类及其自身价值 v_i(q) 来制定策略。 因此，出价者知道自己所参与出价的提示词的大致类型以及自己的估计价值，但只能通过基于该聚类的先验分布了解竞争对手的价值。 在每个聚类内部，我们通过虚拟博弈法求解（近似的）贝叶斯-纳什均衡，该方法在价值和可能出价两个维度上均使用离散化网格（详见附录 D）。 均衡未必是唯一的，某些均衡的福利水平可能远低于其他均衡。 因此，我们对每个市场进行两次求解：一次求解典型均衡，即在每个迭代中，出价者将其策略更新为最接近当前出价且能最大化剩余价值的最佳响应，直至收敛；另一次求解（同样近似的）对抗性均衡，即在每个迭代中，每个出价者选择能最小化福利但仍最多保留 5% 相对遗憾值的个体最佳剩余价值响应，直至收敛。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Welfare within a market is pooled over all prompts and reported as a fraction of the first-best oracle, OPT = 𝔼 ⁡ [ max i ⁡ v i ​ ( q ) ] \operatorname{OPT}=\mathbb{E}[\max_{i}v_{i}(q)] , which we call the “realized PoA” to distinguish it from the worst-case bounds of Section 3 . By a “market” we mean a subset of the 110 110 models bidding against each other, and most of our experiments draw many such subsets at random, with the sampling scheme stated in each case. Every number we report is therefore computed over prompts and over sampled markets. Since the bounds we are testing are worst-case statements, we report both the mean and the 0.1 0.1 -percentile ( p0.1 ) of realized PoA across markets, 5 5 5 We use 99.9 % 99.9\% coverage instead of the minimum to avoid outlier markets where the solver has not converged. and we compare both against the competitive-floor bound of Theorem 3 evaluated on the same market (where like the equilibrium strategies, the bound is computed using the empirical distribution of the bidder values). We also track how much the winner shades, 1 − 𝔼 ⁡ [ B winner / V winner ] 1-\mathbb{E}[B_{\mathrm{winner}}/V_{\mathrm{winner}}] . Note, however, that shading (i.e., low winning bids) on its own does not cost welfare, since queries are misallocated only when bidders shade by (problematically) different amounts. Finally, as bidders condition on the cluster (see "Strategic bidding" above), each of the 20 20 clusters is effectively its own auction, and the pooled welfare averages over them. As a robustness measure, we also report welfare on the worst cluster , i.e., the cluster where a given allocation rule does worst.

sents.en: Metrics.
sents.zh: 指标。

sents.en: Welfare within a market is pooled over all prompts and reported as a fraction of the first-best oracle, OPT = 𝔼 ⁡ [ max i ⁡ v i ​ ( q ) ] \operatorname{OPT}=\mathbb{E}[\max_{i}v_{i}(q)] , which we call the “realized PoA” to distinguish it from the worst-case bounds of Section 3 .
sents.zh: 市场中的福利是所有提示词的综合结果，并以第一最佳预言机 OPT = 𝔼⁡[maxᵢ vᵢ(q)] 的分数形式报告；我们将其称为“实际实现的 PoA”，以区别于第 3 节中最坏情况下的界限。

sents.en: By a “market” we mean a subset of the 110 110 models bidding against each other, and most of our experiments draw many such subsets at random, with the sampling scheme stated in each case.

sents.zh: 因此，我们报告的所有数值都是基于提示词和抽样市场计算得出的。

sents.en: Since the bounds we are testing are worst-case statements, we report both the mean and the 0.1 0.1 -percentile ( p0.1 ) of realized PoA across markets, 5 5 5 We use 99.9 % 99.9\% coverage instead of the minimum to avoid outlier markets where the solver has not converged. and we compare both against the competitive-floor bound of Theorem 3 evaluated on the same market (where like the equilibrium strategies, the bound is computed using the empirical distribution of the bidder values).

paragraphs.en: Results on the full EmbedLLM market. Table 1 reports a single auction run on the full dataset with all 110 110 models bidding against each other. The auction at equilibrium is nearly perfectly efficient, reaching 99.2 % 99.2\% of oracle welfare at the typical equilibrium and 98.8 % 98.8\% at the adversarial one. Both exceed the baseline of routing each cluster to its own best model ( 89.4 % 89.4\% ), and are well above the baseline of committing to one model everywhere ( 78.1 % 78.1\% ). The gap widens on each rule’s worst cluster, where the single best model retains only 6.0 % 6.0\% of first-best and per-cluster routing 64.0 % 64.0\% , while the auction holds 96.0 % 96.0\% and 93.0 % 93.0\% . Bidders see their own value v i ​ ( q ) v_{i}(q) before bidding, so a specialist can outbid the cluster leader on exactly the prompts where the leader is weak, which is what a fixed rule cannot do. On the full market and prompt distribution, Theorem 3 guarantees a welfare ratio ≥ 79.9 % \geq 79.9\% (and a minimum bound of 67.6 % 67.6\% on the worst cluster). Both are substantially above the naive 1 − 1 / e 1-1/e bound, though still below what the market achieves. The 1 − 1 / e 1-1/e bound holds for every market and so cannot indicate anything more specific about this one, whereas 79.9 % 79.9\% is computed from the empirical value prior of this market, and correctly signals that welfare will be high. Note that we do not expect it to be tight, since the bound only uses the competitive floor and treats everything else as worst case, while near-independence ( Section 4 ) is a second and separate reason this market can be efficient.

paragraphs.en: Results on randomly sampled EmbedLLM sub-markets. Moving beyond the full EmbedLLM market setting, we next look at welfare in thousands of auctions among subsets of EmbedLLM models. Figure 2 (left) plots the empirical distributions of both (a) the competitive-floor bound of Theorem 3 , and (b) the realized welfare ratio at a typical equilibrium over 100 ​ k 100k randomly sampled model subsets of market size n ∈ { 2 , 5 , 10 } n\in\{2,5,10\} . paragraphs.en: Results on illustrative EmbedLLM cohorts. Random sub-markets vary in both how good their best model is and how much competition it faces. To separate the two, Table 2 shows results for four hand-picked cohorts of n = 4 n=4 models with nearly identical first-best welfare ( 𝔼 ⁡ [ max i ⁡ V i ] ≈ 0.55 \mathbb{E}[\max_{i}V_{i}]\approx 0.55 ) but different market structure. In the similar cohort, the four models are comparable 7 7 B chat models (Starling-LM-7B-beta, OpenChat-3.5-0106, Zephyr-7B-beta, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1) with average values between 0.43 0.43 and 0.51 0.51 . In the diverse cohort (Qwen-1.5-7B-Chat, BioMistral-7B-DARE, ANIMA-Nectar-v2, and Zephyr-beta-math), the models have an even tighter range of average values ( 0.42 0.42 to 0.46 0.46 ), but they are good at different things, so on a given prompt the runner-up tends to trail the winner by more ( 17.1 % 17.1\% versus 7.7 % 7.7\% ). For both cohorts the competitive-floor bound limits the welfare loss to well below the worst case of 1 / e ≈ 36.8 % 1/e\approx 36.8\% , and the limit is lower for the similar cohort ( 24.2 % 24.2\% versus 27.4 % 27.4\% ). Actual losses are small in both, but the winner shades much more in the diverse cohort ( 19.8 % 19.8\% versus 12.3 % 12.3\% ), so the similar cohort loses slightly less welfare ( 0.4 % 0.4\% versus 1.2 % 1.2\% ). Nevertheless, the bidder diversity here is only mild, as every model is still a credible rival on many prompts. When a "generalist" (Yi-34B-Chat) is paired with three weaker, "niche" models (Qwen-1.5-0.5B-Chat, DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct, and Gemma-2B-it), the runner-up trails by 35.6 % 35.6\% on average, the winner shades by 29.1 % 29.1\% , the loss bound rises to 29.9 % 29.9\% , and the welfare loss rises to 5.1 % 5.1\% . Swapping one niche model for a second generalist is enough to bring the welfare loss back down to 0.8 % 0.8\% , even though half the cohort is still weak (here the generalists are SOLAR-10.7B-Instruct and Neural-Chat-7B-v3-3, paired with Qwen-1.5-0.5B-Chat and Gemma-2B-it). These results support our core intuition that value concentration limits shading and thereby reduces overall welfare loss.

paragraphs.en: Prior work on agentic markets has focused on dominant strategy incentive-compatible (DSIC) mechanisms, where bidding one’s true value (or cost, in a procurement auction) is optimal. Chang et al. (2020) first used second-price auctions to solve general, sequential Markov decision problems (though not with modern AI agents), while more recent work has used Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auctions to orchestrate LLM agents ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and reverse second-price auctions to allocate test-time compute ( Velasco et al., 2026 ) . These mechanisms, however, do have significant weaknesses—such as being susceptible to collusion ( Robinson, 1985 ) and requiring bidders to trust the auctioneer ( Rothkopf et al., 1990 ; Ausubel and Milgrom, 2004 ) . In this paper we study the viability of the first-price auction, and argue that its lack of truthfulness is less of a concern under value structures we expect agentic markets to have, such as competitive floors and weakly dependent values.
paragraphs.zh: 关于智能体市场的前期研究主要集中在占优策略激励相容（DSIC）机制上，在这种机制中，报出真实价值（或在采购拍卖中报出真实成本）是最优选择。Chang 等人 （2020）首次使用第二价格拍卖来解决一般的、序列性的马尔可夫决策问题（尽管当时尚未采用现代人工智能智能体），而近期的研究则利用维克瑞-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）拍卖来协调大型语言模型智能体（Liu 等人，2026），并使用反向第二价格拍卖来分配测试时的计算资源（Velasco 等人，2026）。 然而，这些机制存在显著弱点——例如容易受到合谋的影响（Robinson，1985），并要求投标者信任拍卖人（Rothkopf 等人，1990；Ausubel 和 Milgrom，2004）。 在本文中，我们研究了第一价格拍卖的可行性，并认为，在我们预期智能体市场所具有的价值结构（如竞争底限和弱依赖价值）下，其缺乏真实性的问题并不那么令人担忧。

paragraphs.en: The price of anarchy (PoA) of first-price auctions is well studied. Smoothness arguments ( Roughgarden et al., 2017 ) give a universal 1 − 1 / e ≈ 0.632 1-1/e\approx 0.632 bound under arbitrary correlation ( Syrgkanis and Tardos, 2013 ; Christodoulou et al., 2016 ) . For independent private values, the bound was later raised to 0.743 0.743 ( Hoy et al., 2018 ) , and then to 1 − 1 / e 2 ≈ 0.865 1-1/e^{2}\approx 0.865 , which is tight ( Jin and Lu, 2023a ) . All of these bounds are worst case over the value distribution, and they remain tight even for the best equilibrium ( Jin and Lu, 2023b ) . We show how these bounds can improve under additional structure on the values. Related settings have their own beyond-worst-case results. For example, when a bidder’s value depends on what others privately know, the PoA of simple auctions can be poor, but improves when information is spread evenly ( Eden et al., 2021 ) . Revenue guarantees can also be shown to be robust to small changes in the prior ( Brustle et al., 2020 ) , similar in spirit to our weak dependence result ( Section 4 ), where the 1 − 1 / e 2 1-1/e^{2} bound degrades smoothly with distance from independence even as equilibrium strategies shift. Finally, our experiments connect to empirical approaches to the PoA ( Hoy et al., 2017 ; Hartline, 2026 ) , and to average-case analyses that weight equilibria by how likely learning dynamics are to reach them ( Panageas and Piliouras, 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 第一价格拍卖的无政府状态价格（PoA）已有广泛研究。 平滑性论证（Roughgarden 等，2017）在任意相关性假设下（Syrgkanis 和 Tardos，2013；Christodoulou 等，2016）给出了一个普适的 1 − 1 / e ≈ 0.632 的界。 对于独立私有价值情形，该界后来被提升至 0.743（Hoy 等，2018），随后进一步提升至 1 − 1 / e² ≈ 0.865，且这一界是紧的（Jin 和 Lu，2023a）。 所有这些界都是针对价值分布的最坏情况，即使在最佳均衡情形下，它们仍然是紧的（Jin 和 Lu，2023b）。 我们展示了在价值结构具备额外特性时，这些界如何得到改进。 相关设定也存在各自超越最坏情况的研究成果。 例如，当投标人的价值取决于他人所掌握的私人信息时，简单拍卖的 PoA 可能表现不佳，但若信息能被均匀传播，则 PoA 会改善（Eden 等，2021）。 还可以证明，收入保证对先验分布的小幅变化具有鲁棒性（Brustle 等，2020），这与我们的弱依赖性结果（第 4 节）在思想上一致：即使均衡策略发生变动，1 − 1 / e² 的界也会随着偏离独立性的程度而平滑下降。 最后，我们的实验与 PoA 的经验性研究方法（Hoy 等，2017；Hartline，2026）以及平均情况分析方法相关联——后者通过学习动态达到各均衡的可能性来对均衡进行加权（Panageas 和 Piliouras，2016）。

paragraphs.en: This paper analyzes the welfare of first-price auctions (FPAs) among AI agents, where the main objection to non-truthful mechanisms like the FPA is that they are vulnerable to welfare loss from bid shading. Worst-case price of anarchy bounds are pessimistic, but agentic markets often have structure that narrows the gap. We prove that the welfare guarantee rises toward full efficiency when the strongest few bidders have similar values, and that the 1 − 1 / e 2 1-1/e^{2} bound for independent values degrades smoothly when values are only weakly dependent (e.g., given the query). Finally, we show that platforms themselves can take simple steps to protect the efficiency of their markets, such as filtering out weak bidders with routing rules, or entering their own models to set competitive reserve prices.
paragraphs.zh: 本文分析了人工智能智能体之间第一价格拍卖（FPA）的福利问题，其中对非真实机制（如FPA）的主要质疑在于，它们容易因出价虚报而遭受福利损失。 最坏情况下的“无政府状态价格”界限虽然较为悲观，但智能体市场通常具有能够缩小这一差距的结构特征。 我们证明了，当少数最强投标者的估值相近时，福利保障会趋近于完全效率；而当估值仅存在弱依赖关系（例如在给定查询的情况下）时，独立估值情形下的 1 − 1 / e^{2} 界限会平滑下降。 最后，我们指出平台本身可以通过简单措施来保护市场效率，例如通过路由规则过滤掉弱势投标者，或引入自身模型以设定具有竞争力的保留价格。

sents.en: This paper analyzes the welfare of first-price auctions (FPAs) among AI agents, where the main objection to non-truthful mechanisms like the FPA is that they are vulnerable to welfare loss from bid shading.

sents.en: Worst-case price of anarchy bounds are pessimistic, but agentic markets often have structure that narrows the gap.
sents.zh: 最坏情况下的“无政府状态价格”界限虽然较为悲观，但智能体市场通常具有能够缩小这一差距的结构特征。

sents.en: We prove that the welfare guarantee rises toward full efficiency when the strongest few bidders have similar values, and that the 1 − 1 / e 2 1-1/e^{2} bound for independent values degrades smoothly when values are only weakly dependent (e.g., given the query).
sents.zh: 我们证明了，当少数最强投标者的估值相近时，福利保障会趋近于完全效率；而当估值仅存在弱依赖关系（例如在给定查询的情况下）时，独立估值情形下的 1 − 1 / e^{2} 界限会平滑下降。

sents.en: Finally, we show that platforms themselves can take simple steps to protect the efficiency of their markets, such as filtering out weak bidders with routing rules, or entering their own models to set competitive reserve prices.
sents.zh: 最后，我们指出平台本身可以通过简单措施来保护市场效率，例如通过路由规则过滤掉弱势投标者，或引入自身模型以设定具有竞争力的保留价格。

paragraphs.en: We assume that models and users are aligned in the sense that positive utility derives only from providing value to the user; external sources of utility, such as advertising placement, would obviously require additional analysis. Second, like all price of anarchy results, our bounds only describe bidders who play equilibrium strategies. Auctions composed of agents that are still learning how to bid, or that bid by simple heuristics, could result in realized welfare that is quite a bit worse (or better!) than the welfare at any equilibrium bidding strategy. Extending our analysis to include realistic learning dynamics for first-price auctions in agentic markets is a valuable next step. Third, we analyze competitive floors and near-independence separately, and in experiments we only compute the competitive-floor bound. Real markets like EmbedLLM appear to have both properties ( Section 6 and Section C.1 ). Taking the larger of the two guarantees is immediate, but a bound that uses both properties together could be stronger, but is non-trivial. We leave this to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设模型与用户之间存在一致性，即正向效用仅源于为用户创造价值；而广告位等外部效用来源显然需要额外分析。 其次，与所有“无政府状态价格”相关结论一样，我们的界限仅适用于采用均衡策略的竞拍者。 由仍在学习如何竞拍或仅依赖简单启发式方法竞拍的智能体组成的拍卖，其实现的福利可能比任何均衡竞拍策略下的福利差得多（甚至好得多！）。 将我们的分析扩展到包含智能体市场中第一价格拍卖的现实学习动态，是一个有价值的后续步骤。 第三，我们分别分析了竞争底线和近似独立性，并在实验中仅计算了竞争底线界限。 像 EmbedLLM 这样的真实市场似乎同时具备这两种特性（第 6 节和第 C.1 节）。 直接取两者中较大的保证即可，但若能结合两种特性共同使用的界限可能会更强，不过实现起来并非易事。 我们将此问题留待未来研究。

sents.en: We assume that models and users are aligned in the sense that positive utility derives only from providing value to the user; external sources of utility, such as advertising placement, would obviously require additional analysis.
sents.zh: 我们假设模型与用户之间存在一致性，即正向效用仅源于为用户创造价值；而广告位等外部效用来源显然需要额外分析。

sents.en: Second, like all price of anarchy results, our bounds only describe bidders who play equilibrium strategies.
sents.zh: 其次，与所有“无政府状态价格”相关结论一样，我们的界限仅适用于采用均衡策略的竞拍者。

sents.en: Auctions composed of agents that are still learning how to bid, or that bid by simple heuristics, could result in realized welfare that is quite a bit worse (or better!) than the welfare at any equilibrium bidding strategy.
sents.zh: 由仍在学习如何竞拍或仅依赖简单启发式方法竞拍的智能体组成的拍卖，其实现的福利可能比任何均衡竞拍策略下的福利差得多（甚至好得多！）。

sents.en: Extending our analysis to include realistic learning dynamics for first-price auctions in agentic markets is a valuable next step.
sents.zh: 将我们的分析扩展到包含智能体市场中第一价格拍卖的现实学习动态，是一个有价值的后续步骤。

sents.en: Third, we analyze competitive floors and near-independence separately, and in experiments we only compute the competitive-floor bound.

sents.en: Real markets like EmbedLLM appear to have both properties ( Section 6 and Section C.1 ).

sents.en: Taking the larger of the two guarantees is immediate, but a bound that uses both properties together could be stronger, but is non-trivial.

sents.en: We leave this to future work.
sents.zh: 我们将此问题留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we focus on welfare in this paper. Revenue matters to the platform and its price of anarchy can behave quite differently ( Hartline et al., 2014 ) ; we leave revenue guarantees to future work.

It is interesting to consider what this implies with respect to our bounds in Section 3 . paragraphs.en: Note, however, that a similar straightforward connection cannot be made to Theorem 3 ! In fact, the bound in Theorem 3 can get worse, since positive dependence can make bidders fall below the floor on the same queries, which raises ϵ \epsilon relative to independent values with the same marginals. We leave a closer study of how dependence between values affects competitive floors to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 但请注意，与定理 3 无法建立类似的直接联系！ 事实上，定理 3 中的界限可能会变得更差，因为正相关性可能导致投标者在相同查询上的报价低于底价，从而使得 ϵ \epsilon 相对于具有相同边缘分布的独立值而言有所上升。 关于值之间的相关性如何影响竞争底价这一问题，我们将在未来的工作中进行更深入的研究。

paragraphs.en: The results in the main text apply to a fixed value prior μ \mu . However, as in Section 4 , it is reasonable to assume that each query in an agentic market comes with public information X X that all bidders see before they bid (such as the prompt text), which induces a conditional prior μ x := μ ( ⋅ ∣ X = x ) \mu_{x}:=\mu(\cdot\mid X=x) . As with μ \mu , we assume each μ x \mu_{x} is common knowledge among the bidders. We can then apply Theorem 3 conditionally to each query, with its own α x \alpha_{x} , m x m_{x} , and ϵ x \epsilon_{x} , and subsequently average over X X .
paragraphs.zh: 正文中的结果适用于一个固定的先验值 μ。 然而，与第 4 节中的情况一样，可以合理地假设，智能体市场中的每个查询都附带公共信息 X，所有投标者在出价前都能看到该信息（例如提示文本），由此产生条件先验 μ x := μ ( ⋅ ∣ X = x )。 与 μ 的情况类似，我们假设每个 μ x 都是投标者之间的共同知识。 然后，我们可以对每个查询有条件地应用定理 3，使用其各自的 α x、m x 和 ϵ x，随后对 X 进行平均。

paragraphs.en: This section gives additional results for the EmbedLLM market experiments described in Section 6 . Specifically, Section C.1 tests the conjecture from Section 4 that bidder values are close to independent once the prompt is known. Sections C.2 and C.3 then empirically evaluate the two platform design choices from Section 5 : a platform-owned bidder and pre-auction filtering of weak models.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提供了第 6 节中描述的 EmbedLLM 市场实验的补充结果。 具体而言，C.1 节检验了第 4 节中的推测：一旦提示词已知，投标者的价值就接近于相互独立。 随后，C.2 和 C.3 节通过实证方法评估了第 5 节中提出的两种平台设计选择：由平台拥有的投标者以及拍卖前对弱模型的筛选。

sents.zh: 具体而言，C.1 节检验了第 4 节中的推测：一旦提示词已知，投标者的价值就接近于相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Section 4 conjectures that most of the dependence between bidder values in agentic markets can be eliminated by conditioning on the query , so that values are close to independent once the query is known. Recall from Section 6 that v i ​ ( q ) = max ⁡ ( 0 , 𝔼 ^ ​ [ acc i ∣ q ] − c i ) v_{i}(q)=\max(0,\hat{\mathbb{E}}[\mathrm{acc}_{i}\mid q]-c_{i}) , where the accuracy estimate averages over the k = 16 k=16 nearest neighbors of q q . These estimates follow the intuition that a model performs similarly on similar queries. In our construction this holds exactly by design, since every model’s value on a prompt is averaged over the same neighbors, which favors the prompt as a predictor here. The general idea still holds more broadly. Much of what makes models succeed or fail together is a property of the query itself, such as its difficulty, its topic, or how clearly it is specified ( Hofmann et al., 2025 ; Fisch et al., 2024 ; Maimon et al., 2026 ) —and routers already estimate per-query model performance from the prompt ( Ong et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Next, we test the platform participation strategy of Section 5 on randomly sampled markets from EmbedLLM. Each market contains the strongest EmbedLLM model, n n rivals drawn at random, and a platform model that bids its own value on every prompt. The platform model is the EmbedLLM model at a given percentile of the ranking by average value, where 0 0 is the weakest model and 1 1 is the strongest (so at 1 1 the platform runs a copy of the best model). Rivals are never drawn from the platform models used at any percentile. This lets us reuse the same random draws of rivals at every percentile, so each curve compares the same markets. For each percentile and n ∈ { 5 , 10 } n\in\{5,10\} we draw 10,000 10{,}000 random markets and solve for typical and adversarial equilibria as in Section 6 .

paragraphs.en: Finally, we test pre-auction filtering with a router that admits a model to a prompt’s auction only if the model is close to the strongest model on the prompt’s cluster. Specifically, model i i may bid on cluster c c if 𝔼 ⁡ [ V i ∣ c ] ≥ β ​ max j ⁡ 𝔼 ⁡ [ V j ∣ c ] \mathbb{E}[V_{i}\mid c]\geq\beta\max_{j}\mathbb{E}[V_{j}\mid c] , where the maximum runs over the models in the market. Setting β = 0 \beta=0 admits everyone, and β = 1 \beta=1 admits only the cluster leader. Because the rule works at the cluster level, it can drop the model with the highest value on a particular prompt. We therefore measure welfare against the first-best of the unfiltered market, and also report the filtered oracle, which is the upper bound of Equation 8 . For each β \beta and n ∈ { 5 , 10 } n\in\{5,10\} we draw 10,000 10{,}000 random markets.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们测试了拍卖前过滤机制，该机制使用一个路由器：仅当模型在提示词簇中的表现接近最强模型时，才允许其参与该提示词的拍卖。 具体来说，模型 i 可以竞标簇 c，前提是 𝔼 [ V i ∣ c ] ≥ β ​ max j ⁡ 𝔼 [ V j ∣ c ] \mathbb{E}[V_{i}\mid c]\geq\beta\max_{j}\mathbb{E}[V_{j}\mid c]，其中最大值遍历市场中的所有模型。 设置 β = 0 时允许所有模型参与，而 β = 1 时仅允许簇内最强模型参与。 由于该规则在簇层面生效，它可能会排除某个特定提示词下价值最高的模型。 因此，我们将福利水平与未过滤市场中的最优情况进行比较，同时报告过滤后的理想结果，即方程 8 的上界。 对于每个 β 和 n ∈ { 5 , 10 }，我们生成 10,000 个随机市场。

paragraphs.en: Results are shown in Figure 5 . For β ≤ 0.6 \beta\leq 0.6 the router removes only weak models, and the filtered oracle stays near 1 1 while mean welfare is unchanged at about 0.99 0.99 . The adversarial lower tail, however, does improve slightly over this range, from 0.947 0.947 to 0.960 0.960 at n = 5 n=5 and from 0.964 0.964 to 0.968 0.968 at n = 10 n=10 . Past β = 0.7 \beta=0.7 the router starts dropping models that would have been best on some prompts. Consequently, the filtered oracle falls, and realized welfare falls with it, down to about 0.91 0.91 when only the cluster leader bids. As expected, filtering with a router helps only while it keeps the strongest models. At β = 1 \beta=1 the auction reduces to a cluster router that sends every prompt to its cluster’s best model, and this baseline (gray lines) is below the auction at every β < 1 \beta<1 , in both the mean and the 0.1 0.1 percentile.
paragraphs.zh: 结果如图 5 所示。 当 β ≤ 0.6 时，路由器仅移除较弱的模型，过滤后的 oracle 值接近 1，而平均福利保持不变，约为 0.99。 然而，在此范围内，对抗性下尾略有改善：在 n = 5 时从 0.947 提升至 0.960，在 n = 10 时从 0.964 提升至 0.968。 当 β 超过 0.7 后，路由器开始移除本应在某些提示中表现最佳的模型。 因此，过滤后的 oracle 值下降，实际实现的福利也随之下降，当仅集群领导者出价时，降至约 0.91。 正如预期，使用路由器进行过滤仅在它能保留最强模型时有效。 在 β = 1 时，拍卖简化为一个集群路由器，将每个提示转发至其集群中的最佳模型；这一基准（灰色线条）在所有 β < 1 的情况下均低于拍卖结果，无论是在平均值还是在 0.1 百分位上。

paragraphs.en: We compute approximate Bayes–Nash equilibria with a damped form of fictitious play ( Rabinovich et al., 2013 ; Heymann and Mertikopoulos, 2026 ) , implemented directly on the empirical distribution of values. Fictitious play goes back to Brown (1951) , and approximating Bayes–Nash equilibria numerically by iterating best responses over a restricted family of strategies is standard for auctions without closed-form solutions ( Armantier et al., 2008 ; Bosshard et al., 2020 ) . Each cluster of prompts is solved on its own. Within a cluster, every prompt is one draw from the joint distribution of the bidders’ values, so the solver keeps whatever correlation the data has and never replaces it with a product of marginals or a smoothed prior. Fictitious play has no general convergence guarantee in first-price auctions, but Heymann and Mertikopoulos (2026) find that it converges numerically to approximate equilibria across a wide range of first-price auctions with correlated values, which is our setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过阻尼虚拟博弈（Rabinovich 等人，2013；Heymann 和 Mertikopoulos，2026）计算近似的贝叶斯-纳什均衡，并直接将其应用于价值的经验分布。 虚拟博弈可追溯至 Brown（1951），而通过在一个受限的策略族中迭代最佳响应来数值近似贝叶斯-纳什均衡，则是没有闭式解的拍卖中的标准方法（Armantier 等人，2008；Bosshard 等人，2020）。 每个提示词簇都独立求解。 在一个簇内，每个提示词都是从竞拍者价值联合分布中抽取的一个样本，因此求解器会保留数据中存在的所有相关性，而绝不会将其替换为边缘分布的乘积或平滑后的先验分布。 虚拟博弈在第一价格拍卖中并不具备普遍的收敛保证，但 Heymann 和 Mertikopoulos（2026）发现，它在具有相关价值的第一价格拍卖的广泛范围内能够数值收敛到近似均衡，这正是我们所研究的情形。

paragraphs.en: Checks. The typical and adversarial runs share everything except the choice among best responses, so an adversarial equilibrium should never have higher welfare than a typical one on the same market. When it does, the solver has not settled, and we drop the market (for example, this removes at most 9 % 9\% of markets in the filtering experiment of Section C.3 ). The check compares welfare over all of a market’s prompts, not cluster by cluster. We also report the 0.1 0.1 percentile of welfare across markets in place of the minimum, so that a few unsettled markets do not drive the results.
paragraphs.zh: 检查。 典型运行与对抗性运行除了最佳响应的选择之外共享所有要素，因此，在相同市场中，对抗性均衡的福利水平绝不会高于典型均衡。 如果确实如此，说明求解器尚未稳定，此时我们将放弃该市场（例如，在 C.3 节的筛选实验中，这最多会移除 9% 的市场）。 该检查比较的是整个市场所有提示词的福利，而非按簇比较。 我们还报告各市场福利的 0.1 百分位数以替代最小值，从而避免少数未稳定的市场影响结果。

paragraphs.en: We prove the qualitative Theorem 5 by comparing an equilibrium under the conditional joint distribution μ x \mu_{x} with the same strategies under the product of its marginals, ν x \nu_{x} . Changing the distribution mildly can destroy exact optimality, but it creates only small regret. The main step is to show that small regret under independence also leaves only a small shortfall from the Jin–Lu welfare guarantee. We then transfer this bound back to μ x \mu_{x} . Before moving to the proof of the weak dependence result (Theorem 5 ), we first record the simpler robustness argument for the 1 − 1 / e 1-1/e guarantee, which allows arbitrary correlation ( Roughgarden et al., 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过比较在条件联合分布 μ x \mu_{x} 下的均衡与在其边缘分布的乘积 ν x \nu_{x} 下采用相同策略的均衡，来证明定性的定理 5。 对分布进行轻微改变可能会破坏精确的最优性，但只会产生较小的遗憾。 主要步骤是证明：在独立性假设下较小的遗憾，也只会导致与 Jin–Lu 福利保证之间出现较小的差距。 然后我们将这个界限反向转移到 μ x \mu_{x} 上。 在转向弱依赖性结果的证明（定理 5）之前，我们首先记录用于 1 − 1 / e 1-1/e 保证的更简单的鲁棒性论证，该论证允许任意的相关性（Roughgarden 等，2017）。

paragraphs.en: For a high-level overview of the proof, suppose small regret could coexist with a fixed positive welfare shortfall. Choose a sequence of such independent-values auctions with regret tending to zero. Compactness gives limiting value–bid distributions, and recording the winner preserves the limiting utilities and welfare. Lemma F.2 ensures that feasible deviations still attain nearly the best limiting utility. Lemma F.3 then shows that the limit can be represented as an exact equilibrium, including a bid-only rule for newly formed ties. The positive shortfall would contradict the Jin–Lu bound.
paragraphs.zh: 为了从宏观上理解该证明，假设较小的遗憾值可以与固定的正福利赤字共存。 选择一系列此类独立价值拍卖，其遗憾值趋于零。 紧性可得出极限的价值-出价分布，而记录获胜者则能保留极限效用和福利。 引理 F.2 确保可行的偏离仍能几乎达到最佳的极限效用。 随后，引理 F.3 表明该极限可以表示为一个精确的均衡，包括对新生成的平局采用仅出价规则。 正福利赤字将违背 Jin–Lu 界。

paragraphs.en: For the limit of the auction itself, we keep each bidder’s joint distribution of value and bid, rather than take pointwise limits of bidding functions. paragraphs.en: Lemma F.5 first shows that higher values lead to higher bids and that no single bid amount has positive probability. Lemma F.6 then bounds the value associated with each bid and the surplus retained by the bidder. These bounds allow Lemma F.7 to compare how raising a bid changes the chance of winning under the dependent prior and under independence. Lemma F.8 uses these facts to construct a nearby equlibrium with independent values in three steps. First, it determines the required changes in the bidder’ bid distributions jointly, accounting for intervals in which a bidder originally places no bids. Second, it bounds the size of these changes using the preceding optimality comparisons. Third, it proves that the constructed bids are globally optimal for their assigned values and controls the resulting change in bid distributions in total variation. In the proof of Theorem F.4 , we apply the Jin–Lu guarantee to this equilibrium and transfer the welfare bound back to the original auction. Finally, the derivative assumption bounds the uniform departure from independence by a constant times the total variation distance, giving the claimed linear error.
paragraphs.zh: 引理 F.5 首先表明，数值越高，出价也越高，并且任何单一出价金额都具有正概率的可能性都不存在。 接着，引理 F.6 对每个出价所关联的数值以及投标人保留的剩余价值设定了界限。 这些界限使得引理 F.7 能够比较：在依赖先验分布的情况下与独立情况下，提高出价如何改变获胜的概率。 引理 F.8 利用这些事实，通过三个步骤构建一个具有独立数值的邻近均衡。 首先，它共同确定了投标人出价分布所需的变化，并考虑了投标人最初未进行任何出价的区间。 其次，它利用前面的最优性比较，对这些变化的规模设定了界限。 第三，它证明了所构建的出价对于其分配的值而言是全局最优的，并控制了由此导致的出价分布在总变差上的变化。 在定理 F.4 的证明中，我们将 Jin–Lu 保证应用于此均衡，并将福利界限转换回原始拍卖。 最后，导数假设将偏离独立性的均匀差异限制为一个常数乘以总变差距离，从而得到了所声称的线性误差。

paragraphs.en: The higher bid is preferred precisely when this ratio is at least one. Thus, if a lower type weakly prefers a a to b b , every higher type strictly prefers a a . Bid zero cannot be optimal for a positive type. It follows that the sets of optimal bids are ordered across types. For each type with more than one optimal bid, choose two such bids and the open interval between them. The ordering of optimal bids makes these intervals disjoint across types. Each contains a rational number, so there are at most countably many such types. The value distributions have densities, and hence the equilibrium is pure and nondecreasing outside a null set of values.
